_comment: runner adopt contract (plan 0.2): every numbered migration is paired with adoption evidence - an explicit probe (SQL returning one boolean), an explicit asserted entry (data-only files with no structural delta; legal only at or below required_through, reported distinctly by adopt), or no entry at all when the file carries runner:postcondition lines the probe derives from (050 onward). required_through is the floor the production database is known to carry (the application demonstrably runs against the 045-era schema); a false probe at or below it is a hard failure. Files above the floor are the uncertainty window: probe true adopts, probe false leaves the file pending for a gated apply - so adopt works whether production is at 45 or 49 without knowing which. The legacy schema_version table is never read.

SELECT coalesce((SELECT pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%sent_unconfirmed%' FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'check_status'), false) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posting_queue WHERE status = 'processing' AND scheduled_for < now() - interval '24 hours')
entries.note: data-only and undecidable in place; the probe asserts the file's EFFECT currently holds (delivery vocabulary present AND no aged limbo rows) - an empty queue without 047's vocabulary is not evidence. False leaves it pending, and the runner:reapply-safe marker lets the gated apply re-run it; the file's UPDATEs are bounded to the same >24h population the probe reads, so a fresh in-flight claim is outside the row set by construction
